whyThisReaderIsIndependent: VF02 built none of these five families, repaired none of them and wrote into no overlay directory, no build script and no shared record. Every measurement below was made in this worktree from the delivered bytes: appearance streams decoded from the fixtures, source /V and /AP read from the pinned binaries, local rasters into /tmp scratchpad only, and the nine counters re-run here rather than read from any builder's report. pdftotext was never relied on alone — it is used only to corroborate what the appearance-level read already found, and on one family (NH) it is the ONLY thing that finds a defect the page cannot show.
grantsNothing: An independent PASS proves a packet is complete. It approves no output, opens no commercial route, creates no fulfillment record and promotes nothing. A FAIL here is a verdict and a repair assignment, never an edit; this lane wrote into no overlay directory and no build script.

PROTECTED_FIELDS.finding: THE SIGNATURE BOX OF THE FEE-WAIVER MOTION CARRIES VISIBLE INK IN BOTH FIXTURES. Packet page 4 is NHJB-2311 page 1, the Motion for Waiver of Filing Fee. Its Signature of Filer box — AcroForm field sig.8, widget /Rect [322.444, 303.983, 189.297 x 15.84], reaching the page as flattened appearance /FlatWidget-735569487 — carries the string 'Enter /s/ before name', set in /TiBo 12pt at fill 0.75 g. Rasterised here at 150 dpi it is plainly legible grey text sitting on the signature rule, directly above the printed label 'Signature of Filer'. The packet did not write it: it is the source form's own placeholder appearance, whose /TU reads '(If filing electronically, please type /s/ then your name to sign this document. Ex. /s/ John Doe)'. The field map refuses sig.8 with refusalClass signature_or_date_participant_completion and the reason 'you sign this yourself'; refusing to WRITE a field does not clear the appearance the source ships in it, and this family has no entry in data/rcap-all50/shared/field-appearance-semantics.json, so the structural default preserve_source_appearance carried it through. Under that registry's own vocabulary the correct disposition is render_participant_value_only_when_written — a placeholder is a participant input, and 'unwritten, it contributes nothing, so the source placeholder or default never reaches the filing'. This packet ships flattened, so the participant cannot make it disappear by typing: they will sign, or write /s/, over grey text that is already there. participant-instructions.md step 7 discloses it ('The signature line on NHJB-2311 already reads "Enter /s/ before name". That is the form's own instruction') and reads it as court text; the tooltip and the render-on-type behaviour say it is a placeholder, not printed form text. SECOND, INVISIBLE INSTANCE OF THE SAME CLASS, on the sworn financial affidavit: NHJB-2328 fields 12.total, money.total and monthly.total each ship /V '0' and an appearance stream '(0.00) Tj' at fill 1 g — WHITE. The build preserved all three. On the page they are invisible: rasterised at 150 dpi the three Total lines are blank. In the delivered text layer they are not: pdftotext -layout of fixtures/canonical.pdf returns 'Total $ 0.00' three times — on the weekly take-home total (page 6, item 12), the money-presently-available total (page 6, item 13) and the monthly household expense total (page 7, item 14) — while every line feeding each total is blank. That is a sworn zero for income, for available money and for monthly expenses, extractable by any e-filing system, reader or indexer that reads the text layer of what was filed. participant-instructions.md step 6 tells the participant 'The form prints Total $ 0.00 under each column... Cross the 0.00 out and write the real total' — an instruction to strike through something that does not appear on the paper. THE REPAIR: add tx-style entries to data/rcap-all50/shared/field-appearance-semantics.json for this family — nh_petition_nonconviction_pre2019-set:NHJB-2311 field sig.8 and nh_petition_nonconviction_pre2019-set:NHJB-2328 fields 12.total, money.total, monthly.total — all four disposition render_participant_value_only_when_written, with sourceAppearanceWhenUnwritten 'Enter /s/ before name', '0', '0', '0' and the widget rects above; then correct step 6 and step 7 of participant-instructions.md, which describe an artifact that will no longer exist. This is the identical defect the TX Statement of Inability entry already documents and suppresses: 'two sworn zeroes on financial lines the participant never answered, and a date on the Option 1 declaration page beside a signature line the packet deliberately leaves blank.'

SELF_HELP_STOP.finding: THE PACKET DOES NOT STATE WHERE SELF-HELP ENDS, AND THE COMMITTED RECORD THAT SAYS WHERE IT ENDS IS FULLY POPULATED. data/record-clearing/legal-design-track-registry.json holds a track nh_petition_nonconviction_pre2019 carrying eight selfHelpStopConditions (nine selfHelpBoundaries). NOT ONE OF THE EIGHT REACHES THE PARTICIPANT. Searched, by exact string and then by topic word, across every .md and .json in the family directory and across pdftotext of the delivered canonical: 0 of 8 present; the words firearm, immigration, background-check, opposition, tribal and '3 years' appear nowhere in participant-instructions.md. The instructions file has no stop section at all — its headings run 'One offence, one petition', 'Where you file this', 'What it costs', 'What you must do before you file', four per-form item tables, 'The choices that are yours', 'What the platform deliberately left blank', 'What annulment does, and what it does not do' — and the nine delivered pages are the four official forms, with no composed instructions page on which a stop could live. The nearest sentence, 'this packet does not decide whether you are eligible for one', is a disclaimer of what the packet is; it names no condition, no lawyer and no legal-aid resource. FOUR OF THE EIGHT ARE SUBSTANTIVE WARNINGS A PARTICIPANT CAN BE HARMED BY NOT HAVING: RSA 651:5, IV bars a further petition more often than every three years, so a participant who was denied within the last three years is about to spend $125 on a petition the statute bars; the annulment will not be recognised federally or for immigration; RSA 651:5, XVII says a private background-check database need not remove the record; and annulment does not restore firearm rights. THE MEASUREMENT IS COMPARATIVE, not a standard invented here: the same registry diff run against the other three official-pdf-fill families this lane holds returns in_arrest_no_charges 13 of 13 carried, ri_decriminalized 5 of 5, tx_nd_veterans_court 7 of 7. Only New Hampshire returns zero. THE REPAIR: add a 'Where self-help ends' section to participant-instructions.md carrying the eight registry conditions in the registry's own words, with a named New Hampshire legal-aid or lawyer-referral resource, in the shape the Indiana, Rhode Island and Texas families already use.

The participant expects a private background-check database to remove the record. RSA 651:5, XVII says it need not.
The participant expects annulment to restore firearm rights. It does not.

COMPONENT_SET.finding: Four components, ten pages, all present: the state's own instructions and motion (DC-33 pages 1-2 as packet pages 1-2), the state's own affidavit (DC-33 pages 3-4 as packet pages 3-4), a composed proposed order (5-6) and composed filing instructions (7-10). The proposed order exists because the court's own instruction 7 says 'Bring the Order for Expungement or Sealing of Record to the hearing' and Rhode Island publishes no template for it; the composed page says so on its own face.

KNOWN_PREFILLS.finding: Two held values, written and visible where they belong: participant.full_legal_name and participant.date_of_birth, in the caption of the motion (page 2) and in the caption of the affidavit (page 3), and again in the composed proposed order's caption. Placement checked against the printed captions at the same y: the name at x 73.3 sits under 'Defendant' at x 77.2, the date of birth at x 436.1 under 'Date of Birth' at x 440.6. Every case fact — case number, BCI number, counts, charges, dispositions, judicial complex, hearing date, notice date, police department — is a court-record fact the platform has not seen and is declared and disclosed.

REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING.finding: All 25 declared items carry a disclosure label present in participant-instructions.md, and the composed filing-instructions pages repeat the substantive ones on the paper the participant holds.

ROUTE_OPTIONS.finding: BOTH route-determined elections are MADE on the delivered page, verified by raster rather than by text extraction — these marks are drawn as vector glyphs and no text extractor sees them. Packet page 2: 'The Defendant requests that the above-referenced case containing the following charge(s) be [X] expunged [ ] sealed' — expunged marked, sealed not; and the second decree election, 'All records and records of conviction relating to the conviction of the above-referenced case be expunged... pursuant to G.L. 1956 12-1.3-3(c) or (e)', marked. The pinned source rendered at the same crop shows BOTH boxes empty, so the marks are this packet's and are correct for a route whose committed legal name and statutory authority are an expungement. Every sworn affidavit box in every Part is left unmarked, and the composed instructions say so in terms: 'NOT ONE OF THOSE BOXES IS MARKED FOR YOU, in that Part or in any other.'

evidence.method: 150 dpi raster of the delivered page 2 compared with the same crop of the pinned source

REPEATING_ROWS.finding: No row carries a written cell beside a blank required cell. The motion's four-row Count/Charge/Disposition grid on page 2 is entirely blank, and the composed proposed order reproduces the same four rows blank with the reason printed beside them: 'Copy them from the motion; they are not filled in here because the platform has not seen the court record they come from.'

PROTECTED_FIELDS.finding: No signature, signature date, certificate of mailing, court-only or prosecutor-only field carries ink. The motion's '/s/ ______' signature line and its date line are blank; the certification line on page 2 that the Attorney General and the charging police department were notified — date and department name — is blank, and the composed instructions state why ('A certification that notice has been given, signed and dated before notice was actually given, is a false statement to a court'); the affidavit's Signature of the Defendant and the entire notarial certificate on page 4 are blank; the hearing date and courtroom, which the composed instructions record as the Clerk's Office's to fill, are blank. On the composed proposed order everything below the line marked 'EVERYTHING BELOW THIS LINE IS THE COURT'S' — findings, grant/deny, relief marked, terms, signature, date of entry, certification, seal — is blank.

ARTIFACTS.finding: Both fixtures rehash to the sha256 and byteLength reports/rendered-artifacts.json records, and both equal the digests the raster receipt is bound to.

PAGE_ORDER.finding: The ten-entry page manifest matches the artifact page for page. The official pages keep the source's own order (DC-33 1,2 then 3,4) and the composed pages follow, which is the order the court's instruction 7 implies: motion, affidavit, order to bring to the hearing.

CLIPPING_AND_OVERLAP.finding: Rasterised here at 100 dpi: every page 850x1100 px, zero dark pixels in the 18-point edge band on every page of BOTH fixtures — including the boundary fixture, whose 39-character name with a typographic apostrophe and 1972 date of birth both fit their caption cells.

FILING_DESTINATION.finding: 'WHERE IT GOES. The court where the conviction occurred. File the correct court's Motion to Expunge or Seal Record with the proposed order, with the clerk of the court where the conviction occurred.' It also names the one thing the participant must pick: the motion lists four District Court judicial complexes and the packet states that it has not seen the docket and does not know which is theirs.

evidence.destination: clerk of the RI District Court division where the conviction occurred

FEE_AND_WAIVER.finding: Stated, sourced and — importantly — qualified. Quoted from the committed record: 'No cost to the petitioner. Where the conditions of the original sentence are complete and all fines, fees and costs related to the conviction are paid in full, the court orders the expungement without cost.' The packet then reads that back to the participant rather than leaving it as a headline: the no-cost expungement is CONDITIONED on completion and on a zero balance, 'It is not a fee waiver and it does not clear an outstanding balance. Ask the clerk for a record showing the balance is zero before you file.'

evidence.fee: no cost, conditioned on completed sentence and zero balance
evidence.waiverRoute: not applicable; the relief itself is without cost when the condition is met

SERVICE.finding: Who and when are both stated from the motion's own certification line: under G.L. 1956 12-1-12.1(b)(1) or 12-1.3-3(a) the Office of the Attorney General AND the police department that originally brought the charge must be notified, and the hearing date must be at least ten days after. The packet then corrects the order the page reads in — file, then the Clerk sets the date, then give notice, then complete the certification — and states that it prints no service address because it holds none for the Attorney General or for any Rhode Island police department and does not guess one.

whoIsServed: the police department that brought the charge
evidence.noticePeriod: at least 10 days before the hearing

SELF_HELP_STOP.finding: 'WHEN TO STOP AND GET HELP INSTEAD' carries all five selfHelpStopConditions the committed legal-design track registry records for ri_decriminalized, in the registry's own words, including the two that are genuinely hard — that establishing decriminalisation is a legislative-history question not answerable from the docket, and the relationship between this route and the 12-1.3-1(5) reclassification overlay. The packet adds the affidavit rule that matters most: 'An unmarked box is a gap; a marked box that is not true is a false statement under oath.'

ROUTE_IDENTITY.finding: Built for obligation:track-only:TX:tx_nd_veterans_court — an order of nondisclosure under Gov't Code 411.0727 after successful completion of a veterans treatment court programme — on the OCA model petition and order for that exact section. The delivered page 1 title is 'Petition for Order of Nondisclosure Under Section 411.0727' and its paragraph 1 is headed 'Completion of Veterans Treatment Court Program'. The packet also does the thing this route most needs and no counter measures: it puts the EXPUNCTION overlap first, on the instructions page and in participant-instructions.md, because art. 55A.053(a)(2)(A) with the 30-day order under art. 55A.203 and no fee destroys the record where this route only seals it.

SOURCE_IDENTITY.finding: All three official sources resolve BY CONTENT HASH across the two mounted custodies. 7c34e5f5... (OCA petition, REV-2022-02) and 2c950020... (OCA order, REV-2022-02) under master_library STATES/TX/02_PACKET_FORMS; bd17a3fe... (Statement of Inability to Afford Payment of Court Costs, Misc. Docket No. 22-9090) under human-source-returns/TX. Every declared digest was recomputed from the bytes on disk and matched.

COMPONENT_SET.finding: Five components, twenty-five pages, all rendered and present: the OCA petition (1-6), the OCA proposed order (7-9), a composed conditional proof of delivery to the prosecutor (10), the twelve-page Statement of Inability (11-22) and composed filing instructions (23-25). Both conditional components carry a stated condition: the proof of delivery is used only where local practice requires it, because 411.0745(e) makes the COURT responsible for notifying the State, and the Statement is used only where the participant elects it in paragraph 6 of the petition.

KNOWN_PREFILLS.finding: Thirteen flattened widget values plus two composed-text writes, all present in the bytes and all under their own printed label: the petitioner's name in the petition caption and paragraph, in the signature block's Printed Name, on the order's Defendant line, on the Statement's 'My full legal name is', its Option 1 'My name is' and its Option 2 'Your printed name'; the phone on the petition signature block and the Statement; the address, e-mail and date of birth on the Statement; and the name on the composed proof of delivery and instructions page. Page 6 was read at the appearance level to confirm the block is the PETITIONER's — 'Respectfully submitted / Signature / Printed Name / Address / City, State, Zip / Telephone Number' — and not an attorney block; the petition carries no attorney or bar-number field at all.

REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING.finding: All 114 declared items carry a disclosure label that appears in participant-instructions.md, which lists them per component and then adds a 'Things the platform deliberately left blank' section naming the address split, the offence and cause number, every financial fact on the Statement, the Option 1 date and the district attorney's details.

ROUTE_OPTIONS.finding: One route, one instrument set, and the route is stated rather than asked: the petition is the 411.0727 petition and the order the 411.0727 order, by their own printed titles. The two controls left to the participant are genuinely theirs and neither is route-determined — Dropdown6, whether evidence of completing the programme is attached (a fact about what the participant did), and Group7, whether they pay the fees or file the Statement of Inability (a financial election the platform holds no fact for). requiredOptionsMissing measured zero.

REPEATING_ROWS.finding: No row carries a written cell beside a blank required cell. The Statement's five-row dependants table, its income, benefit, property, expense and debt tables and the petition's offence line are all entirely blank in both fixtures.

PROTECTED_FIELDS.finding: No signature, signature date, certificate of mailing, court-only or prosecutor-only field carries ink, AND — the point of this family — no source-carried value reaches the flattened page uninvited. THE ENCLOSED STATEMENT OF INABILITY SHIPS THREE OF ITS OWN VALUES, and all three are gone from the delivered bytes: field 'Value / Valor 11' /V '0', 'Amount Cantidad 15' /V '0' and 'Today' /V '12/15/2022', read first-hand from the pinned source at human-source-returns/TX. Measured on the delivered canonical at the rects data/rcap-all50/shared/field-appearance-semantics.json records, only the form's own printed '$' signs appear at the two money rects on packet page 18, and pdftotext over all 25 pages returns no occurrence of 12/15/2022 anywhere. The Option 1 declaration date line on page 21 is a blank rule. THE PETITION SHIPS ONE TOO: OCA Dropdown6 carries /V and /DV 'is not' in the source, and it does NOT reach delivered page 1 — the page's seven flattened widget Do calls are Court, Name1, County, Name2, Offense, Cause No and Date5_af_date, and Dropdown6 is not among them, so the packet does not assert on the participant's behalf that they attached nothing. The OCA order ships no default at all. On the pages themselves: the petition's Signature widget on page 6 is an empty appearance, the order's judge, hearing and finding lines are blank, and on the Statement pages 21 and 22 the signature, the date, the county-and-state line and the whole notary block ('The notary fills out this section') are blank.

evidence.howMeasured: source /V read with pdf-lib from the three pinned binaries; delivered appearances decoded from the canonical bytes and checked at the registry's own rects; pdftotext over all 25 pages

ARTIFACTS.finding: Both fixtures rehash to the sha256 and byteLength reports/rendered-artifacts.json records and both equal the digests the raster receipt is bound to.

PAGE_ORDER.finding: The 25-entry page manifest matches the artifact page for page, and each official page carries its source page number and its source digest: petition source pages 1-6 to packet 1-6, order 1-3 to 7-9, proof of delivery to 10, Statement source pages 1-12 to packet 11-22, instructions to 23-25.

CLIPPING_AND_OVERLAP.finding: Measured two ways on BOTH fixtures. Rasterised here at 100 dpi: every one of the 25 pages is 850x1100 px with zero dark pixels in the 18-point edge band. Then the boundary fixture, which is where a fitter fails: its 79-character address and 58-character e-mail were measured at 150 dpi against their own widget rects on pages 12 and 21 — right-hand collar zero dark pixels in every case, with the fitter having shrunk the address to 7.5pt on page 12 and 9.5pt on page 21 to achieve it. No value is hard-split, truncated or broken mid-token in either fixture.

FILING_DESTINATION.finding: 'File the petition with the CLERK OF THE COURT THAT SENTENCED YOU or placed you on community supervision', with the difference that matters named: this is NOT the county of arrest, which the committed record calls the single biggest venue difference from expunction, so a participant pursuing both may be in two different courts. Gov't Code 411.0745(a) filing methods (in person, electronically or by mail) and the OCA direction to submit the proposed order with the petition are both stated.

evidence.destination: clerk of the Texas court that sentenced the participant or placed them on community supervision

FEE_AND_WAIVER.finding: Both stated, and the packet does something better than publish a figure: it explains why there is no statutory one. 411.0745(b) sets the TYPE of fee (the fee that generally applies to filing a civil case), not an amount, so the county's civil schedule governs; OCA describes the total as typically about $280 varying by county and tells the filer to call the clerk, and the packet repeats that instruction. It then names the number to IGNORE — the $28 that belongs only to the no-petition route under 411.072(c) — which is exactly the kind of cross-route figure a fee statement most often gets wrong. Waiver: paragraph 6 of the petition elects between paying and filing the Rule 145 Statement of Inability, which is in the packet, with the Rule 145 entitlement stated (the clerk must make the form available without charge and without being asked).

evidence.fee: the county's civil filing fee under Gov't Code 411.0745(b); OCA describes the total as typically about $280, varying by county
evidence.waiverRoute: Tex. R. Civ. P. 145 Statement of Inability to Afford Payment of Court Costs, enclosed as component 4

SERVICE.finding: Stated with the statutory position and the practical one both named: 411.0745(e) makes the COURT responsible for notifying the State and the committed record says the filer should not be charged for that notice, but OCA instructions nonetheless direct the petitioner to show proof the district attorney received a copy and some counties expect it. The packet therefore ships the proof of delivery as a CONDITIONAL component with 'READ THIS FIRST: YOU MAY NOT NEED THIS PAGE' printed at its head and the instruction to ask the clerk which applies in that county. No district attorney name or address is printed and the page says why.

evidence.whoServes: the court notifies the State under 411.0745(e); the proof of delivery is conditional on local practice
evidence.proofOfDeliveryCarryingInk: the petitioner's own name only; the DA name, address, method and date are blank

SELF_HELP_STOP.finding: Present and complete against the prescribed instrument: all 7 selfHelpStopConditions the committed legal-design track registry records for tx_nd_veterans_court are carried, in the registry's own words, and the packet adds five more of its own taken from assertions the enclosed forms actually make — including the one that decides the route, that entering the programme as a result of a DWI conviction puts the matter outside 411.0727(e) while the proposed order asks the judge to find the opposite. It also names where self-help stops for facts: the clerk for filing mechanics and the county fee, and DPS Crime Records Service for the criminal history the other-offence questions depend on.

observationsThatFailNoObligation.what: The petition's signature block splits the filer's address across two blanks (Address at rect [317.04, 552.36, 198.36 x 28.8] and City State Zip at [317.04, 504.24, 198.36 x 28.8], both packet page 6) and both are left blank, while participant.street_address — held as ONE line, '42 Live Oak Street, Austin, TX 78702' — is written twice in the same packet, on the Statement of Inability at pages 12 and 21.
observationsThatFailNoObligation.whyItIsNotAFailure: The completeness contract's availability test asks whether the platform holds a value for THE FACT the field asks for. These two blanks ask for the street part and the city/state/zip part separately, and the platform holds neither as a separate fact; splitting a one-line address by guessing where the street ends would invent structure it does not have. The refusal is declared, reasoned in those terms, and disclosed in participant-instructions.md ('Both parts of your address on the petition, because that block splits what the platform holds as one line').
observationsThatFailNoObligation.worthWatching: if the platform ever holds structured address parts, these two blanks become writable and the refusal stops being correct.

observationsThatFailNoObligation.what: The composed proof-of-delivery page (packet page 10) prints the internal route key 'Route: obligation:track-only:TX:tx_nd_veterans_court' as a footer on a page a participant may file with a court.
observationsThatFailNoObligation.whyItIsNotAFailure: It is a footer on a full, self-describing page, not a route-key-only or fragment page, and the same convention appears across composed pages in this factory.
observationsThatFailNoObligation.worthWatching: an internal identifier on a filed page is a product question, not a completeness one.

ROUTE_IDENTITY.finding: custom_pleading for obligation:runtime-only:OK:human-trafficking-survivor-relief under 22 O.S. 19c. The petition states the route in its title, its body ('This petition is brought on the route the committed route contract records as "Human-trafficking survivor relief", under 22 O.S. Sec. 19c'), and its footer. Critically for THIS route the packet also states, as its first substantive line, the compiled record's own routing instruction: that trafficking-survivor matters go to legal aid or an attorney because the petition needs sensitive facts and supporting proof.

SOURCE_IDENTITY.finding: custom_pleading from codified text: no official form bytes are bound by design, and source-receipt.json says so — no committed record names an official participant form for this route. The three committed records it does bind were each rehashed from their repository bytes here and all three match exactly: the route contract src/lib/legal-authority/routes/route-splits.json (c573d65a..., 127996 bytes), the compiled profile src/lib/rcap-engine/compiled/profiles/OK-oklahoma.json (74134460..., 227605 bytes) and the route-obligation census. There is no official-form sha to rehash and none is claimed.

COMPONENT_SET.finding: The committed contract names two packet components for this route, 'Petition under Sec. 19c' and 'Trafficking nexus evidence'. The packet composes the pleading pages and says in terms which of the two is a RECORD the participant obtains rather than a page this packet can write: 'anything on that list that is a RECORD rather than a pleading is a document you obtain and file with the petition.' Both composed components are rendered: the primary filing on pages 1-2 and the filing instructions on pages 3-4.

KNOWN_PREFILLS.finding: Every held fact is written and visible on the page it belongs to: the petitioner's name in the caption ('IN RE: Jordan Avery Reyes, PETITIONER.'), in section B, on the PRINTED NAME line and on the instructions page; date of birth in section B; mailing address, telephone and e-mail in the contact block at the foot of the petition. Six case facts (C1 existing court and county, C2 case number, C3 prostitution-related offence, C4 disposition and date, C5 relief requested under 19c, C6 trafficking-nexus evidence) are court-record or counsel-advised facts the platform has never seen, each declared and each disclosed.

REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING.finding: All 6 declared items are named in participant-instructions.md by their printed item labels (Item C1 through Item C6), each with what the participant must supply and where to get it, and each is printed on the petition itself as a labelled dotted blank. The instructions split them correctly: copy C1-C4 from the existing court file, complete C5-C6 only as legal aid or an attorney advises.

ROUTE_OPTIONS.finding: No election control exists on any composed page, which is the correct answer for a one-route composed pleading: the petition states its statutory ground in its title, body and footer rather than printing a box to tick. The field map states the discipline explicitly — 'Where a neighbouring section of the same statute is a different route, the packet says so and tells the participant to stop rather than printing a box to tick.'

REPEATING_ROWS.finding: The packet has no repeating table. Each of the six case-fact items is a single labelled block with its own dotted rules, and every one is uniformly blank.

PROTECTED_FIELDS.finding: No signature, signature date, certificate of mailing, court-only or prosecutor-only field carries ink, and the packet says so on its own face. Page 2 reads 'DATE .............................. SIGNATURE OF PETITIONER ....................................' followed by '(The petitioner signs and dates this petition personally. Nothing on this page is signed or dated for the petitioner.)'. The case-number line on page 1 is left blank and labelled 'Case number, if the court assigns one at filing'. PRINTED NAME is filled, which is correct — a printed-name line is not a signature — and the signature rule beside it is empty. Because this is a composed pleading there are no source widgets and so no source-shipped defaults to strip.

ARTIFACTS.finding: Both fixtures rehash to the sha256 and byteLength reports/rendered-artifacts.json records (12383 and 12563 bytes, 4 pages each) and both equal the digests the current raster receipt is bound to.

PAGE_ORDER.finding: The four-entry page manifest matches the artifact page for page and component for component: primary filing pages 1-2, filing instructions pages 3-4. The delivered order is petition then instructions, which is the order the manifest names.

CLIPPING_AND_OVERLAP.finding: Rasterised here at 100 dpi: all four pages 850x1100 px, zero dark pixels in the 18-point edge band on every page of BOTH fixtures, with the ink box on every page inside x 100-746 and y 90-985 of 850x1100. No line is broken mid-token and no value overruns its dotted rule.

FILING_DESTINATION.finding: Stated with its own uncertainty named rather than papered over: the committed census records the destination as not recorded and the compiled profile records only that relief 'can be by court motion or petition' without naming the court, so the packet names the office that answers both questions — the court clerk of the Oklahoma district court for the county in which the case was filed — and prints that same description in the caption line ('IN THE ............ COURT (the Oklahoma district court for the county in which the case was filed)'). It invents no courthouse.

evidence.destination: office of the court clerk of the Oklahoma district court for the county in which the case was filed

FEE_AND_WAIVER.finding: Stated as a refusal with an authority to ask: no committed record this packet binds states a filing fee or a fee waiver for this route, and the office that answers both is named. It publishes no figure and imports none from a neighbouring section of Title 22 — which is the discipline that matters most on 19c, since the ordinary 18/19 expungement rules are a different route and the packet says so.

evidence.namedOfficeToAsk: office of the court clerk of the Oklahoma district court for the county in which the case was filed

SERVICE.finding: Stated on the same terms: no committed record this packet binds says who must be served on this route or how, and the office that answers it is named. The packet does not invent a service rule for a statute whose form of process the compiled record leaves open between motion and petition.

evidence.serviceStated: none recorded; named office to ask

SELF_HELP_STOP.finding: Present, and it is the strongest section of this packet. 'WHEN TO STOP AND GET HELP INSTEAD' carries five stops taken from the compiled Oklahoma profile and the committed contract, led by the compiled record's own routing instruction, and the packet repeats the survivor-safety boundary in three separate places — 'Do not write a survivor narrative on this petition' on page 1, 'Do not write an account of what was done to you on any page of this packet' on page 3, and 'the facts that establish the connection are yours to tell and yours alone' on page 4. Item C6 asks the participant to IDENTIFY the trafficking-nexus evidence by document type, title or date and issuer, expressly not to narrate it. The registry diff cannot be run: data/record-clearing/legal-design-track-registry.json holds no track whose routeKey is obligation:runtime-only:OK:human-trafficking-survivor-relief, and the family binds the route contract, the compiled profile and the census rather than the registry — so the stops were measured against the records the family actually binds.

defectFoundThatFailsNoObligationByName.what: RAW MARKDOWN IS RENDERED LITERALLY INTO THE DELIVERED PLEADING. The filing-instructions page of BOTH fixtures prints, as body text under 'WHEN TO STOP AND GET HELP INSTEAD': '- **this is the first thing the committed record says about this route:** Oklahoma has a special expungement pathway for certain prostitution-related records connected to human trafficking victimization.' The asterisk pairs are markdown emphasis delimiters that were never rendered. pdftotext -layout of fixtures/canonical.pdf and of fixtures/boundary.pdf each return exactly one line containing '**' — canonical line 148, boundary line 149. The same string carries the same delimiters in participant-instructions.md, where it IS markdown and renders correctly, and in production-field-map.json's participantFacingObligations SELF_HELP_STOP answer, which is where the composer read it from: the composer carried a markdown source string onto a PDF page that does not render markdown.
defectFoundThatFailsNoObligationByName.whyItIsNotScoredAsASelfHelpStopFailure: Every recorded stop condition is present, complete and legible; the delimiters are cosmetic and change no meaning. Failing SELF_HELP_STOP on it would be inventing a defect class the obligation does not carry. This is the same call VF09 recorded at base 09b741ad on the identical defect in composed-treatment:obligation:runtime-only:WV:sex-trafficking-victim-vacatur-and-expungement, and it is followed here for consistency rather than reasoned afresh.

location.line: - **this is the first thing the committed record says about this route:**

defectFoundThatFailsNoObligationByName.repair: strip or render markdown emphasis in the composer that writes participantFacingObligations answers onto a composed page; the same composer produces the WV instance, so the repair is shared and not this family's alone.
defectFoundThatFailsNoObligationByName.consequenceForPromotion: this row is a PASS on the fifteen named obligations. It is not a recommendation to promote the family while a filed page prints raw markup.

observationsThatFailNoObligation.what: The petition (page 2) and the instructions page (page 4) each print the internal route key 'Route: obligation:runtime-only:OK:human-trafficking-survivor-relief' as a footer.
observationsThatFailNoObligation.whyItIsNotAFailure: a footer on a full, self-describing page, not a route-key-only or fragment page; the same convention appears on composed pages across this factory.

summary.supersededReceiptsCorrectlyMarked: the OK family carries two superseded receipts bound to digests that match no file now on disk; both are marked superseded and the current receipt is over the current bytes.
